column1: # memory5 (kit-q-memory5): its 15 checks, judged from the run's journal, bus and memory snapshots (lines.tsv's steps).
# A check is PASS, FAIL, VOID (a deciding line not seen spoken by the test face, so not judged) or INCONCLUSIVE
# (wake word misheard, a switch off, nothing to judge). hard: a privacy or forget promise; one FAIL fails the set.
# counts: yes is in the score; report (T1, T2, their first week, until two stable runs set a baseline) is never in
# the score, but counts as judged for the VOID rule when it is heard and decided (PASS or FAIL).
# The set PASSES when all 7 hard checks pass and the counted judged checks pool to 0.90 or more (the two rules
# agreed on #8567); the put-back read-back must be clean. Fewer than 12 of the 15 judged: VOID (memory5: VOID, test owed).
# C2 follows the product as it is: LAMP_PRIVATE_ROOM leaves memory's scopes unchanged, so a line with no face seen
# speaking it is the room's (LAMP_PERSON_SCOPE_SEEN) and a person's fact is not kept (LAMP_MEMORY_PERSONAL_NEEDS_FACE).
